gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all custom fields in my Jira instance to understand what data is available for reporting.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all custom fields with their IDs, names, and types.

gold.user: As a product owner, I need to create a new custom field for tracking user feedback, so I can gather insights from our users.
gold.ideal: The API should create a custom field and return the new field's ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to fetch custom fields in a paginated manner to efficiently handle large datasets in my application.
gold.ideal: The API should return a paginated list of custom fields with metadata about the pagination.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to see all trashed fields to decide which ones to restore or permanently delete.
gold.ideal: The API should return a paginated list of trashed fields with their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a team lead, I need to update the configuration of an existing custom field to better suit our project's needs.
gold.ideal: The API should update the specified custom field and return the updated field's details.

gold.user: As a QA engineer, I want to check the contexts associated with a custom field to ensure it is used correctly in different scenarios.
gold.ideal: The API should return the contexts associated with the specified custom field.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to delete a custom field that is no longer needed to keep our field list clean.
gold.ideal: The API should delete the specified custom field and return a success message.

gold.user: As an admin, I need to restore a previously deleted custom field because it is still relevant to our project.
gold.ideal: The API should restore the specified custom field and return its details.

gold.user: As a product manager, I want to trash a custom field that is no longer relevant to avoid clutter in our field list.
gold.ideal: The API should move the specified custom field to the trash and return a confirmation message.
